rationale: Shanzila and Gediminas both build with LLMs but from complementary angles—Shanzila as a CPO architecting LLM products at ReachLLM, and Gediminas as an AI Engineer applying those models to healthcare at Develop Health. Shanzila's product-focused TypeScript background pairs well with Gediminas's hands-on Python/LLM implementation work, making them natural collaborators for exploring how LLM tooling translates into real-world health-tech applications.
intro_message: Shanzila Ahmed, meet Gediminas Pazera—you're both shipping LLM products (product vs. engineering) and could trade insights on turning LLM capabilities into healthcare solutions.
